description: BESS – огляд системи: потоки потужності, заряд батареї, стан мережі, ціни РДН та економіка

targets.query: from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "battery_soc_pct") |> last()
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "pv_power_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "pv_power_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "battery_power_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "grid_power_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "house_load_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "battery_temp_c") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "grid_voltage_v") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)

import "date"
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "revenue_uah") |> sum()

import "date"
y0 = date.add(d: -1d, to: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
y1 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: y0, stop: y1) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "revenue_uah") |> sum()

import "date"
t0 = date.add(d: 1d, to: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
t1 = date.add(d: 2d, to: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: t0, stop: t1) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "schedule" and r._field == "expected_revenue_uah") |> sum()

panels.title: Термін окупності системи, міс.
panels.description: CAPEX (змінна вгорі дашборду) поділений на середній дохід за останні 30 днів × 30

targets.query:
import "date"
capex = float(v: "${capex_uah}")
avgDaily = from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "revenue_uah") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> mean(column: "_value")
avgDaily |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: capex / (r._value * 30.0) }))

panels.title: Ціна на РДН — реальні дані з oree.com.ua (грн/МВт·год)

targets.query:
import "date"
start = date.add(d: -1d, to: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
stop  = date.add(d: 2d, to: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: start, stop: stop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "market_price" and r._field == "price_uah_mwh")
